RAVINDRA S/O SHRI SARMAN SINGH KUSHWAH,
 ABOUT 20 YEARS, OCCUPATION: ADHYAN R/O GRAM  KEKHODA POLICE THANA SEHOR DISTRICT SHIVPURI  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (MS. UMA KUSHWAH- ADVOCATE)
 AND  STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  THANA SEHOR DISTRICT SHIVPURI (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 ..

 (SHRI PURUSHOTTAM TANWAR- PUBLIC PROSECUTOR)
 This application coming on for hearing this day, the cou  following:
 ORDER

This first bail application has been filed by applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.28/2024 registered at Police Station Sihore, District Shivpuri (M.P.) for offences punishable under Sections 366, 376, 323 and 506 of the IPC.
The applicant is in judicial custody since 21.02.2024.
As per the case of prosecution, father of the prosecutrix reported to PS Sihore, District Shivpuri that his daughter aged around 18 years and 09 months is missing since night of 14.02.2024.
Missing person report was registered at Police Station Sihore.
Prosecutrix was produced by her father and uncle on 16.02.2024 at Police Station Sihore.
Prosecutrix alleged that on 14.02.2024 around 12:00 in the night, she came out of her house to answer the nature's call.
Ravindra Kushwah met her and on the pretext of talking to her, forcefully took her to nearby hillock on his motorcycle.
Ravindra forcefully took her to nearby agricultural field and committed rape on her.

sentences.text: Ravindra slapped her and put a rope on her neck, therefore, she could not shout.
She somewhat manage to escape and went to the agricultural field of her uncle and informed her father on phone.
On such allegations, Police Station Sihore, District Shivpuri registered FIR at Crime No.28/2024 for offences punishable under Sections 366, 376, 323 and 506 of the IPC against Ravindra.
Prosecutrix was forwarded for medico legal examination.
Her statements were recorded under Sections 161 and 164 of CrPC.
Statements of other witnesses were recorded.
Applicant was arrested on 21.02.2024.
He is in custody ever since.
On completion of investigation, final report was submitted on 12.04.2024.
The trial is underway.

Learned Counsel for the applicant, in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that applicant has falsely been implicated in this matter by the prosecutrix under pressure of her family.
It is a case of consensual relationship between two consenting young persons.
After her return, prosecutrix was pressurized by her family members, therefore, she made allegations against the applicant.
Learned counsel further submits that applicant is aged around 20 years and is pursuing studies.
There is no likelihood of absconsion leaving his family, home and studies.
N o criminal antecedent is reported against the applicant.
There is no likelihood of tampering with the evidence as both the parties relate to same socio-economic status.
Jail incarceration is causing hardship to young applicant.
The trial would take time to conclude.
Therefore, applicant may be extended the benefit of bail.
P e r contra, learned Counsel for the State ably assisted by learned counsel for the objector/complainant opposes the bail application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall circumstances of the case, regard being had to young age of the applicant, but without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.

Accordingly, it is directed that applicant Ravindra shall be released on bail in relation to Crime No.28/2024 registered at Police Station Sihore, District Shivpuri (M.P.) for offences punishable under Sections 366, 376, 323 and 506 of the IPC, upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.
